NEUR 512.title: Advanced Neurosurgery I
NEUR 512.description: Selected topics in neurosurgery and the related basic sciences. Given in alternate years.

NEUR 513.title: Advanced Neurosurgery II
NEUR 513.description: The second year of the above program. Given in alternate years.

NEUR 730.title: Correlative Clinical Neurosurgery Rounds
NEUR 730.description: Residents meet with radiology, neuropathology, and active staff members for discussion of problem cases. One and one-half hours weekly.

NEUR 731.title: Neurosurgery Professors Conference
NEUR 731.description: One one-hour session weekly with a member of the active staff, conducted at the bedside or in conference room. Cases reviewed with emphasis on the proper application of diagnostic methods and the indications for operative management.

NEUR 732.title: Neuroradiology
NEUR 732.description: Sessions conducted by members of the Department of Radiology in which case histories are reviewed and related to radiological investigation and interpretation. One hour weekly.

NEUR 733.title: Anatomy and Neuropathology in the Brain
NEUR 733.description: Sessions conducted by a neuropathologist, Department of Pathology. Attended weekly by neurosurgical resident staff. Two hours weekly.

NEUR 734.title: Operative Neurosurgery
NEUR 734.description: Technique of neurosurgical procedures. Anatomy, surgical judgement, pre- and post-operative care. From a general selection of neurosurgical procedures, approximately 950 major neurosurgical procedures per year are carried out under supervision.
